references.text: Describes the first bull that was burned outside the camp, which this verse refers to as 'the first bull'
The bull with its skin, flesh, and dung was burned with fire outside the camp, the same practice as for the sin offering of the congregation
The flesh and skin were burned with fire outside the camp, the same procedure for a sin offering
The sin offering bull and the sin offering goat shall be burned outside the camp on the Day of Atonement
The red heifer was to be led outside the camp and slaughtered there
The bodies of the animals whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest are burned outside the camp. Therefore Jesus also suffered outside the city gate
